_how_to_edit: Each entry is one card in the PROJECTS.LIST panel. Order here = order on the profile.
repo: repository name under github.com/Vrilll (description, stars, languages and 'updated' are fetched live).
logo: path to an image in this repo (svg, png, jpg or webp). Replace the file in logos/ to change a logo.
desc / tags: what the card says. Keep desc under ~100 characters.
After you push a change to this file or to logos/, the 'Generate projects panel' action rebuilds the cards.
